[0] Amazon's early fall Prime Day sale is now officially underway, and alongside a host of fresh discounts, there are also $50 off the brand new Mac Studio and up to $150 off various M5 MacBook Air models. We're also tracking a massive $500 price drop on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro in both Space Black and Silver, ongoing clearance deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, a ton of TV deals, and fresh accessory markdowns from brands like Twelve South and Anker. Here's everything you need to know, rounded up below.

[1] Amazon's M5 Pro MacBook Pro drops to $500 off in Space Black and Silver

[2] While there are still some worthwhile deals on the latest M5 MacBook Air models, we wanted to circle back on the $500 discount Amazon is offering on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro — both the Space Black and Silver configurations are now available at this steep discount.

[3] Amazon is now offering the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro chip, featuring 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage, for $2,699 with free shipping.

[4] This is the lowest price we've tracked over the past several months, but the deal applies to both the Space Black and Silver models this time around — Silver typically sees fewer discounts.

[5] It normally retails for $3,199, so you're looking at a straight $500 off. As we noted before, with many tech discounts these days simply bringing prices back to the original MSRP, this deal is actually $100 lower than the price before Apple's price hike back in late June.

[6] Best-ever 15-inch M5 MacBook Air deal drops it to $100 off, $150 off 24GB model

  • [7] 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB: $1,449 ($1,599)
  • [8] 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB: $1,399 ($1,499)
  • [9] 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB: $1,849 ($1,999)

[10] Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 in small and medium sizes see rare clearance deals with up to $200 off select models

[11] The brand new Apple Watch Ultra 4 has officially launched with early launch deals on various configurations, but Amazon is also offering a number of deals on the previous-generation but still plenty capable Apple Watch Ultra 3 at much lower prices than the Ultra 4.

[12] The black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop band is the standout deal — originally $899, you can grab it with nearly a $200 discount. Easily the most eye-catching part of this clearance event, though other configurations joined the discount lineup this morning.

[13] One thing to note though: the other configurations are now priced the same as the Milanese Loop version above. But the nearly $200 discount is only available on the large size, while select medium and small sizes are seeing $100 off — these popular medium sizes rarely see deals like this:

  • [14] Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Alpine Loop: $699 ($799) | Medium
  • [15] Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop: $799 ($899) | Medium
  • [16] Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Trail Loop: $699 ($799) | Small

[17] Again, the large black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop remains the best value pick, but given how rare medium-sized deals tend to be, we thought it was worth flagging.

[18] Here are some of the lighter launch discounts on Apple Watch Ultra 4 models:

[19] Apple's brand new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio sees $50 discount at Amazon

[20] In addition to the early launch deal making a return on the more affordable M6 Mac mini, those looking to pick up Apple's earlier-released and more powerful 2026 Mac Studio are finding it at a new low price at Amazon.

[21] Amazon is now offering the brand new Mac Studio featuring the M5 Max chip with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with free shipping.

[22] It normally retails for $2,499, so you're saving $50 right off the bat. The discount isn't huge, but for those looking to upgrade early, it's $50 in your pocket — and that's $1 cheaper than the pre-order deal.

  • [23] 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB: $2,450 ($2,499)

[24] Since Amazon didn't previously officially sell various configurations of the older Mac Studio, it's hard to predict how the discounts on this model will trend. So far, its early launch deals are similar to what we saw with the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon typically discounts aggressively during the early period of new Apple product launches, so it's unclear whether this pro-level machine will see further price drops during Prime Day and Black Friday. There's potential for close to $100 off by the end of the year, but for now, we wouldn't want to say for certain.

[25] Either way, early adopters can pocket some savings, and those who don't need the M5 Max's powerful performance and 36GB of RAM can also check out the following M6 Mac mini configurations, where earlier deals have returned:

  • [26] 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB: $880 ($899)
  • [27] 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB: $1,070 ($1,099)
  • [28] 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB: $1,270 ($1,299)

[29] Twelve South's fall sale takes up to 45% off Find My chargers, MagSafe accessories, and more starting from $21
